title: Create a set of routines for the classroom
text: Create a set of routines for the classroom. These routines should cover transitions, distributing materials, and cleaning up at the end of class for a [grade level] class. Also, provide short responses for these situations: what to do if a student refuses to join an activity, if the class gets too loud, and if a group becomes off-task.
problem: Bahan pengajaran atau sokongan pembelajaran untuk “Create a set of routines for the classroom” belum disediakan.
output: Nota, latihan, kuiz atau rancangan pengajaran (hasil sasaran, belum diuji)
hook: Topik sudah dipilih, tetapi cara menerangkannya masih sukar difahami?
solution: Tugasan: Prompt 131. Tetapkan tahap pelajar, objektif, contoh dan kaedah pentaksiran; semak fakta serta kesesuaian hasil untuk pembelajaran.
cta: Cuba pada satu topik; semak fakta dan sesuaikan kepada tahap pelajar.
